title: nan
authors: Xu H.; Wang C.; Bo Y.; Jiang C.; Liu Y.; Yang S.; Lai W.
key_contribution: Presents an aerial-ground multi-agent cooperative localization framework using collaborative SLAM (ORB-SLAM3, PnP, factor graph) for GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
